name: context-guard
description: Per-session context-window observability. A mod writes each session's context-window figures to a snapshot file and tells Claude its context zone (smart, acceptable or dumb, from bands in zones.json) at each crossing, approach and compaction; the person gets a toast and a transcript line. /context-guard prints status and toggles an optional band row. It answers a status tool. Optional blocking mode gates new mutating work in a blocked zone, except handoffs. A PostCompact hook leaves a marker.

context_guard_hooks_enabled.title: Zone lines, gate and compaction marker
context_guard_hooks_enabled.description: Runs the module's zone lines and blocking gate and the PostCompact marker hook. On by default; off, none of them acts. Snapshot writes continue either way.

zone_lines_enabled.title: Zone lines to Claude
zone_lines_enabled.description: Sends Claude one line when the session crosses into a worse context zone, approaches a boundary, or passes a zones.json threshold, and restates the zone after a compaction, a resume or a reload. On by default.

zone_report_mode.title: Zone report mode
zone_report_mode.description: automatic (default) sends the lines to Claude; operator holds them in a turn a person typed and offers the person a ready-made prompt and a notice row when the turn ends. Headless, loop and schedule turns get automatic lines either way.

zone_line_data.title: Zone line data
zone_line_data.description: Comma list of what a line carries beside its zone, which every line has: percent, tokens and window. Default zone.

zone_hook_mode.title: Zone gate mode
zone_hook_mode.description: advisory (default) sends lines only; blocking also denies new Write, Edit, NotebookEdit, Agent and Workflow calls in the dumb zone past the grace budget, unless zones.json sets an action for the dumb zone. Handoff-path writes, reads, Bash and Skill stay allowed, and an unknown zone fails open.

zone_gate_grace_calls.title: Blocking-gate grace budget (calls)
zone_gate_grace_calls.description: Blocking only: matched tool calls allowed after the session first reaches a blocked zone, before the gate denies. Default 20; 0 denies the first matched call; a value that is not a whole number from 0 to 999999999 reads as 20.

zone_block_unattended.title: Blocking in unattended turns
zone_block_unattended.description: post-compaction (default): in turns no person typed (headless, loop, schedule and notification turns) only a compacted session is blocked; same-as-typed blocks them as typed turns are.

context_guard_band.title: Context band row
context_guard_band.description: Draws the context figure and zone in a row above the prompt. Off by default. Turn it on in /config, or for one session with /context-guard band on.

context_guard_toast.title: Zone-change toast
context_guard_toast.description: Shows a short toast when the session crosses into a worse context zone, beside the transcript line that records it. On by default; off, only the transcript line remains.
